description: This PHP source file defines a validation rule class 'MyTimesheetActionRule' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Time module's API validation rules. The class extends an abstract validator rule and checks if a given input is within a set of allowed timesheet actions provided by the TimesheetService.

classes.name: MyTimesheetActionRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether an input value is an allowed timesheet action.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Overrides the validate method to check if the input is within the predefined set of actions in TimesheetService::TIMESHEET_ACTION_MAP.
